text:
maria: FYI received a SOC2 + HIPAA intake from HealthArc via sales. They want 7y audit logs, per-customer data deletion windows, and evidence for data access reviews. Can we triage and decide if this goes into backlog or requires a Dedicated/private offering?

sam: thanks — pasted their ask below. looks like they want monthly attestation docs + access to raw audit logs on export. any red flags? :eyes:

HealthArc excerpt: "We need 7 years of tamper-evident audit logs, monthly evidence packages for access reviews, and a mechanism to fulfill per-customer deletion requests within 72 hours. Also require HIPAA BAAs and region-based data residency."

jordan: HIPAA + 7y logs = legal + infra implications. Our current retention default is 1y for logs; we do allow longer retention on Dedicated but not exposed via hosted console. We should ask: is it strictly immutable/tamper-evident storage or just exportable signed archives?

lee: from sales: customer is willing to sign a Dedicated contract if needed but wants to know exact scope & timeline before committing. they're asking for implementation estimates to present to their legal/compliance.

nora: engineering quick thoughts — to support 7y immutable logs we'd need cold storage + proof chain (e.g., digest + periodic signing). Also per-customer deletion within 72h conflicts with immutable retention unless we scope which data types are deletable (e.g., request/response vs metadata).

maria: proposed next steps: 1) ask clarifying Qs (is 7y required for all log types?), 2) propose two paths: hosted w/ exportable signed archives (90d default, export available for longer) or Dedicated/private with configured long-term retention & BAA, 3) estimate effort and price delta.

sam: I'll ask the clarifying Qs and flag the timeline ask. Suggested questions: 
- Which events must be retained 7y (admin auth, model I/O, config changes)?
- Is immutability required or will signed export suffice?
- Who will handle key management (customer KMS vs Redwood)?

jordan: add compliance Q: do they need per-customer audit views or a single tenant-level stream? That affects our export tooling. Also include a request for sample questionnaire sections so we can map controls to evidence.

maria: ok i'll collect answers. tagging @compliance-bot for checklist generation and evidence mapping when we have their questionnaire. :thumbsup:

compliance-bot: Next actions queued: 1) Generate control matrix template for SOC2/HIPAA mapping, 2) Create evidence checklist for long-term audit log support, 3) Draft BAA talking points. Use /compliance intake <ticket-id> when ready.

lee: thanks team — once we have answers i'll coordinate with AM and update the customer.

maria: created a JIRA placeholder for prioritization: PRO-1824 (customer-intake: HealthArc logging + retention). tagging product prioritization for next planning board.

nora: if moved to backlog, estimate: spike 1wk (design + legal), implementation 6–8w for Dedicated path, shorter for signed-export option (2–3w), rough numbers.

sam: noted. i'll update thread with customer replies and attach their questionnaire when they send it.
